label.definition: A label is a small sign, usually on something, to tell you about it.
label.sentence: Please read the label before using the product.

labor.definition: Labor is the work that people do, usually lifting, moving, building, etc. rather than desk work.
labor.sentence: The cost of labor is higher than the cost of building materials.

laboratory.definition: A laboratory is a place for scientists to experiment on new things.
laboratory.sentence: The little child entered the laboratory by mistake.

lack.definition: If there is a lack of something, there is not enough of it or it doesn't exist at all.
lack.sentence: He was frustrated by the lack of progress.

lady.sentence: Please direct this lady to the soft furnishings department.

lake.definition: A lake is a place with a lot of deep water. A lake not always have salt in it.
lake.sentence: We went swimming in the lake.

land.definition: Land is the part of the Earth that is not covered with water.
land.sentence: All this land belongs to me.

landscape.definition: A landscape is a piece of land or territory which can all be seen at once in a single view.
landscape.sentence: The landscape of downtown Manhattan is amazing!

language.definition: Language is the usage of words in a specific subject, the vocabulary of the subject.
language.sentence: This document is written in legal language, only lawyers can understand it.

large.definition: Big; of great size; broad, tall, wide, long, or fat.
large.sentence: I would like a large glass of milk.

largely.definition: If something is largely ignored, unknown, thanks to something, etc., it is close to 100% so.
largely.sentence: The changes were largely based on her ideas.

last.definition: Happening or coming after all other similar things or people.
last.sentence: My house is the last house at the end of the street.

late.definition: An event is late if it happens after a specified time.
late.sentence: He was late to his appointment.

latter.definition: The latter half, case, etc. is the second of two.

laugh.definition: Someone laughs when they make a sound with their mouth because they think something is funny. It can sound like "ha ha", "ho ho", "hee hee", etc.

laughter.sentence: Laughter filled the classroom when the teacher accidently spilled her coffee.

launch.definition: If you launch something, you throw it.
launch.sentence: Bob is having a party to launch his new speed boat this weekend.

law.definition: Laws are the official rules of a government or organisation.
law.sentence: We have defined crime as behaviour which breaks the criminal law.

lawyer.definition: A lawyer is an expert in law. A lawyer has the job of standing for other people in court giving them advice about the law.
lawyer.sentence: The defendant got a lawyer to defend him in court.

lay.definition: When you lay something, you place it down flat.
lay.sentence: Lay the books on the table.

layer.definition: A layer is a covering material or substance.
layer.sentence: When we got up in the morning, everything was covered by a thin layer of snow.

lazy.definition: If someone is lazy, they do not want to work or do anything difficult.
lazy.sentence: He went to a restaurant because he was too lazy to cook.

lead.definition: A lead is a wire or strap attached to something.
lead.sentence: The dog can't go far because it's on a short lead.

leader.definition: A leader is someone who leads others and has them following him.
leader.sentence: Johntech is a leader in the microprocessor industry.

leadership.definition: Leadership is the capacity of someone to lead.
leadership.sentence: I doubt that even his leadership can help us.

league.definition: A league is a group of sports teams that play against each other.
league.sentence: The chances of your son making the National Hockey League are close to zero.

lean.definition: If you lean against something, then you push or press against it.
lean.sentence: We can lean on this man.

leap.sentence: The clown took a leap through the hoop.

learn.definition: When you learn something, you start to know how to do things that you didn't know before.

least.definition: Having the smallest amount of a characteristic in a group.
least.sentence: People are least likely to live in the far north.

leather.sentence: He took the leather and made a coat from it.

leave.definition: When you leave a place, you go away from it.
leave.sentence: At what time does your train leave?

lecture.definition: A lecture is a talk about a specific topic. Usually, it is a planned talk and it often lasts a long time.
lecture.sentence: My teacher is giving a lecture on human rights tonight at the university.

left.definition: One of the two directions, the opposite of right. This arrow is pointing left: ←
left.sentence: Turn left at the next corner.

leg.definition: Your legs are the two long parts of your body that you move to walk, or a similar body part on an animal.
leg.sentence: I lost a leg in the war.

legal.definition: If an activity is legal it does not break any laws.
legal.sentence: In Canada, it is perfectly legal for a woman to walk down the street with no shirt on.

legislation.definition: Legislation is the official laws and rules of a government.
legislation.sentence: City council is planning new legislation regarding recycling.

lend.definition: When you lend something to another person, you let them use it, after which they must return it to you.
lend.sentence: The main functions of banks are to hold your money safely and to lend some of that money to others.

length.definition: The length of an object is the distance between one end of that object and the other.
length.sentence: What is the length of the car?

less.definition: Used to form the comparative of some adjectives and adverbs, indicates that the adjective or adverb is less of something.

lesson.definition: A lesson is a time when something is taught.
lesson.sentence: He did the lesson for today.

let.definition: When you let someone do something, you allow them to do it.
let.sentence: I let him come with me.

letter.definition: A letter is a symbol which makes up part of a word.
letter.sentence: I received a letter through the post.

level.definition: Even, flat, straight, smooth, horizontal. Having all parts equally as high as all other parts.

liability.definition: A liability is something for which you are liable or responsible.
liability.sentence: The airline admitted liability for loosing the suitcase.

liberal.definition: If something is liberal, it allows for change, flexibility, and free thought.
liberal.sentence: Japanese schools are quite different from what you see in our more liberal education system.

library.definition: A library is a place where books and other media are kept, usually on shelves. Most of the time, people are allowed to borrow these things.
library.sentence: I borrowed books at the public library today.

license.definition: A license is an official piece of paper that allows you to do something, such as drive, open a business, etc.
license.sentence: When liberty becomes license, dictatorship is near.

lie.definition: If you lie down, your head and whole body are at the same level. You lie down when you want to rest or sleep.

life.definition: Life is what makes a person, animal or plant grow and function.
life.sentence: Scientists want to learn if there is life on other planets.

lift.definition: Someone lifts something when they use their hands to make the thing go up.

light.definition: The energy that our eyes sense is light.
light.sentence: When you leave the room, turn off the light.

like.definition: To like someone or something means to find someone or something pleasant, enjoyable, or interesting.

likely.definition: If something is likely, it is probably true or will probably happen.
likely.sentence: It seems likely that he will miss the meeting.

limit.definition: The limit is the edge of how far something can go. It can go up to the limit but no farther.
limit.sentence: This fence is at the limit of my property.

limitation.definition: A limitation is a restriction that is caused by something or by a certain circumstance.
limitation.sentence: Getting into his wheelchair after his amputation, it felt like a limitation you could roll in.

line.definition: A line is a mark that is long, straight and very thin.
line.sentence: She drew a line down the middle of the page to divide the page into two parts.

link.definition: If you link two or more things, you make a connection between them.

lip.definition: The edge of an opening, especially, the human mouth (often plural).
lip.sentence: She climbed over the lip of the hole.

liquid.definition: A basic state of things that is similar to water. Not solid or gas.
liquid.sentence: She put the liquid in a glass.

list.definition: A list is a group of related words, often in some order, often to help you remember something.
list.sentence: I can't remember if we need milk and I've forgotten the shopping list.

listen.definition: If you listen to something, you try to hear and understand it.
listen.sentence: Shhh! Listen! Did you hear that?

listener.definition: A listener is a person who listens to something talking, usually in an attentive manner.

literally.definition: If something happens literally, it happens exactly as it was said.
literally.sentence: When I found out that the company would hire me, I literally jumped for joy. In fact, I hit my head on the ceiling.

literary.definition: Something literary is something of or related to literature.
literary.sentence: He was a literary expert, knowing vast amounts of information on the works of Charles Dickens and other authors.

literature.definition: Literature is the text of something written.

little.definition: If something is little, its size is not big.
little.sentence: I just ate a tiny little piece of the cake.

live.definition: To be alive; to have life.
live.sentence: He's not expected to live for more than a few months.

load.definition: A load is something carried, often something heavy.
load.sentence: The truck arrived with a load of dog food.

loan.definition: A loan is money that you borrow and pay back later. Usually, you take a loan from a bank.
loan.sentence: We've almost finished paying off our car loan.

local.definition: Something is local if it comes from a specific place. It often it means a place near the person who is speaking.
local.sentence: We do not like fruit grown in other countries. We like to eat local fruit.

locate.definition: If you locate something you find it, you learn where it is.
locate.sentence: I need to locate the nearest gas station.

location.definition: A location is a place or a site.
location.sentence: When you're opening a new business, the choice of location is very important.

lock.definition: A lock is a metal thing on a door (or on a window, drawer, etc.) that stops people from opening the door unless they have the right key to open it.
lock.sentence: No one will take things from my house. I have a very strong lock on the door.

log.definition: A log is a piece of wood that is long and round that has been cut off a tree.
log.sentence: We need another log to make a nice big fire.

logic.definition: Logic is a system of careful step by step thought or argument that tries to explain truth.
logic.sentence: It wasn't easy to see the logic of her plan.

long.definition: If something is long, it takes a lot of time.
long.sentence: That was a long time ago, when I was a child.

look.definition: Someone looks at something when they move their head or move their eyes so that they can see the thing.
look.sentence: Look at this picture! Isn't it beautiful?

loose.definition: If something is loose, it moves easily or may come away from what it is attached to.
loose.sentence: His tooth is loose and will probably come out in a day or two.

lose.definition: When you lose something, you don't know where it is.
lose.sentence: Lose the crowds by climbing a mountain.

loss.definition: A loss happens when something goes where people can't find it. People don't know where the thing is or they don't have it any more.
loss.sentence: The loss of my keys means I can't go into my house today.

lot.definition: A lot of something is a large amount of it.
lot.sentence: I have a lot of things to say.

loud.definition: If a sound is loud, you can hear it very easily. If it's very loud, it might hurt your ears.
loud.sentence: Can you turn down the music, please? It's too loud.

love.definition: When someone loves another person, they feel good about the person and want the person to be happy.

lovely.definition: If someone is lovely, that person is very good to look at. A lovely person is someone that you might love if you saw her or him.
lovely.sentence: She is such a lovely girl.

lover.definition: A lover of someone or something is someone who loves (like very much) that person or thing.
lover.sentence: I'm a real pizza lover, and could eat pizza all day.

low.definition: If cost, value, amount, sound, temperature, etc. is low, it is small.
low.sentence: My pay is very low, so it's hard to live here.

luck.definition: Someone who has good luck is someone who regularly has good things happen to them, almost as if by magic.

lucky.definition: If you are lucky, you have a lot of luck.
lucky.sentence: Today I have three tests, so I'm wearing my lucky hat.

lunch.definition: Lunch is the meal that we eat in the middle of the day.
lunch.sentence: Shall we have sandwiches for lunch?

luxury.definition: A luxury is something that you want that is very expensive.
luxury.sentence: Time is a luxury that we do not have right now.
